title: Landing page and menu still promote wallet and payments the platform no longer offers
standards: EU UCPD Art. 6 / consumer-protection principle of accurate claims — flag for counsel
steps: Open /landing (light/dark screenshots); sign in and view the sidebar.
expected: Marketing and navigation match the subscription-only model: no wallet balances, no 'paid with wallet', no platform payments claim.
actual: The hero badge says 'Social, commerce, payments, services, and AI'; mock cards show 'Wallet 12,480 ETB' and 'Coffee pack paid with wallet'; the sidebar and Quick Links still offer 'Wallet', whose money routes now answer 410.
impact: Sets expectations the product cannot meet and may read as a claim to hold funds — relevant to payment regulation in Ethiopia. Counsel to confirm.
fix: Replace wallet visuals with subscription/showroom examples, remove 'payments' from the hero, hide Wallet navigation for users without a balance, and route remaining balances to the withdrawal screen only.
